{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jaded Jawa''' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was located at the [[Kothlis Starport]]. It was located on a perch eight [[meter/Legends|meters]] above ground, alone a circular wall inside the main terminal dome; it was divided in a dozen booths, and a dimly-lit back room.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The establishment boasted a long [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] window that allowed patrons to look out, however, the crowd in the terminal could not see in. This feature made the cantina a good location to spy on someone.<ref name="guide" /> 

The Jaded Jawa was known as a hotspot for illegal drugs and was never very busy. The food was poor and the drinks were unimaginative. The main reason that people visited the bar was for information. [[Dakkar]] owned this locale at the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="guide" />
